The '''squad''' under the command of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] was a unit within the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[301st Infantry]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Along with the rest of the 301st, Rusk's squad was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and the six-man team fought against [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during their deployment on the ice world.
